title: Aspdin’s kiln, Northfleet
lineage: Notes paraphrase the specified source passages; no source copy is reproduced.

passages.note: Listing dates William Aspdin’s downdraught kiln to about 1846 and states it produced early Portland cement; higher-fired alite-bearing material is distinguished from Joseph Aspdin’s 1824 patent. Exact use of the kiln and chronology require corroboration.
